name: Cislunar-Spandrel
description: Rock deserts and sand seas take turns under a sky like hammered brass. Between dust events the wind redraws an ancient meteor crater, patient as erosion itself.

Light is the weather here. It swings from merciful to murderous within an hour, and everyone schedules their lives around it. Carpet-flora blooms all at once after each rare rain, turning whole basins scarlet overnight.
The oldest impact basin predates the system's estimated age by a comfortable margin. The survey bureau has quietly stopped publishing the numbers.
Whoever controls solar potential controls the approach lanes. Three factions have done the arithmetic, and only two of them are being subtle about it.
